item.title: New OONI Probe TLS Middlebox Experiment
item.description:
We are excited to announce the release of a new OONI Probe TLS Middlebox experiment, designed by Sadia Nourin as part of her OTF Information Controls Research Fellowship with OONI. This experiment was developed as part of her research on measuring and identifying censorship in-transit, wherein intermediary networks censor traffic that neither originates nor is destined for their network.

By running the new OONI Probe TLS Middlebox experiment, you can contribute measurements that help identify the locations of censorship middleboxes around the world. Measurements will be published as open data in near real-time.

item.title: Survey: Collecting Additional Geographic and Network-Level Data with OONI Probe
item.description:
Are you interested in city-level information in OONI data? Would you like to contribute additional geographic and network-level data through OONI Probe? We’d love to hear your feedback!

We released a new OONI Probe TLS Middlebox experiment through which you can help contribute measurements to identify the locations of censorship devices around the world. While the advanced mode of this experiment offers great research opportunities, it also introduces new potential risks.
